versions.content: WriteDataByIdentifier Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the configuration of UDS service 0x2E (WriteDataByIdentifier). Rationale: The service allows for transmitting diagnostic data identified by the association with a diagnostic data identifier to a diagnostic server. This is a frequently used functionality. Use Case: The user wants to transmit data associated with a given data identifier to the diagnostic server. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: More information about this diagnostic service can be found in the respective ISO specification [2].
